answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes. A new identity must complete paid work with 12 distinct counterparties to earn, each deal on a public ledger clear as crystal. Like timber, each real relationship is a load-bearing beam: forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 deals at 5 POA, 60,000 POA locked in real work. A whisper network flags agents whose partners share one wallet cluster. One honest agent pays for 12 real deals and keeps full earnings.
